maddeler.e:
انتأيت (form VIII)
# اِنْتَأَيْتُ (intaʔaytu) /in.ta.ʔaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْتَأَى (intaʔā)
# اِنْتَأَيْتَ (intaʔayta) /in.ta.ʔaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْتَأَى (intaʔā)
# اِنْتَأَيْتِ (intaʔayti) /in.ta.ʔaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَأَى (intaʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
